prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic candid kitchen portrait with warm freckles, dark headband and a confident over-shoulder glance, preserving the visible tattoos and residential setting.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with sun-kissed natural skin, prominent freckles across the nose and cheeks, long wavy dark-blonde hair with lighter balayage and dark roots, held by a thick navy headband. She wears a black ribbed sleeveless high-neck crop top, black tie-side bottoms, small silver hoops and a silver bracelet. Preserve the black line-art tattoos on the left hand, forearm and upper left thigh as supplied visual identity details.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium three-quarter rear-side portrait from a slightly elevated eye level. The adult woman leans forward against the back of a black leather bar stool, twists her torso and looks over her left shoulder with a warm playful smile. Include light oak floor, white shaker cabinetry, white island, stainless appliances, plantation shutters, crystal pendant and distant dining area.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Ample diffused daylight enters from the windows on the right and background, creating gentle highlights on freckles, hair and clothing with natural shadows. Keep the atmosphere bright, domestic and candid.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical 4:5 or 2:3 frame, 28–35mm equivalent lens, subject sharp with recognizable kitchen detail and mild background softening, realistic pores, tattoos, hair and fabric texture, natural color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic candid kitchen portrait of one original approved adult woman with sun-kissed natural skin, prominent freckles across the nose and cheeks, long wavy dark-blonde hair with lighter balayage and dark roots held by a thick navy headband. Use a medium three-quarter rear-side portrait from a slightly elevated eye level; she leans against a black leather bar stool, twists her torso and looks over her left shoulder with a warm playful smile. Use ample diffused daylight, gentle highlights, natural shadows, realistic texture and a candid 28–35mm perspective.
